summary: AAP 2.6 unifies RBAC across components, with Configuration-as-Code collections using standard environment and module variable names (see ansible.platform). Upgrades from the latest 2.5 to 2.6 are supported for RPM, containerized and OpenShift; upgrading directly from the latest 2.4 to 2.6 is recommended for RPM and OpenShift, but EDA 2.4 and 2.4 containerized deployments (Tech Preview) cannot be upgraded.
questions: Can I upgrade directly from AAP 2.4 to 2.6?
Can I upgrade a 2.4 containerized AAP to 2.6?
Which deployment types support upgrading from 2.5 to 2.6?
Can Event-Driven Ansible 2.4 be upgraded to 2.6?

answer_card.title: Supported upgrade paths to AAP 2.6
answer_card.answer_md:
| From | RPM | Containerized | OpenShift |
|---|---|---|---|
| Latest 2.5 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Latest 2.4 | Yes (direct, recommended) | No (2.4 containerized was Tech Preview) | Yes (direct, recommended) |

Event-Driven Ansible 2.4 (Tech Preview) cannot be upgraded; install 2.6 and re-create EDA configuration.
